t: In front of you is Still Water, a large bronze sculpture of a horse's head, made in 2011 by Nic Fiddian-Green. It stands on Achilles Way, near Hyde Park Corner, though it was first installed at Marble Arch. Fiddian-Green is a British sculptor who specialises in lifelike horses' heads, some smaller than life and some larger. The work still belongs to him, and it is here on loan to Westminster City Council.
